verdict.rationale: SigNoz describes itself as an "OpenTelemetry-native platform". Its docs say applications export telemetry over OTLP through standard OpenTelemetry libraries, and SigNoz stores and queries that data alongside other telemetry. Log collection from OpenTelemetry SDKs is also documented. Missing for 10: dedicated OTLP ingestion docs (gRPC/HTTP endpoints, ports, auth/ingestion keys), explicit coverage of direct OTLP export for traces and metrics beyond the LLM-observability page, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
